about: Test utterances as the phone's local speech-to-text might return them (capitalised, punctuated, ASR errors, filler), with the expected parse. A/B hold the normalised span (lowercase, no leading article) or a special token (@mycabin, @cabin:N, @restroom, @elevator, @forelev, @aftelev, @stairs, @deck:N); A = null means the current route start. *_target is the canonical venues.js name the matcher should resolve to. Cabin numbers are made up and are NOT on the HM deck plans (repo rule); tests inject them as a fake cabin fixture: 8924, 6902, 9850, 10930, 10932, 11844, 14906, 9804, 1792, 7646, 12990. 8923, 892 and 9999 are deliberately not in the fixture. Decision-dependent cases are tagged decision_Dn (see voice-commands.md).
scoring: intent must match; cabin must match; for A/B: when *_target is given the resolved target must match, otherwise the span must match after removing spaces/punctuation (special tokens exactly). LOCATION_REFUSED also compares reason; OUT_OF_SCOPE_KNOWN compares topic. Slots are not compared for INCOMPLETE / NO_MATCH / OUT_OF_SCOPE_KNOWN.
